caption:
Commercial due diligence protects your capital and reduces surprises. This checklist guides investors, landlords, building owners, and business owners through essential inspections, records, and verifications before buying or leasing commercial property in Chester County and Montgomery County, Pennsylvania. Focus areas include title and ownership review, zoning and land use, environmental assessments, physical property inspections, and financial document review. Plan for inspection, environmental, title, legal, and advisor fees. Order reports early, coordinate with your attorney and lender, and confirm local permitting and code requirements with municipal offices. Use findings to negotiate, set budgets, and qualify financing. Need a local checklist, vendor referrals, or a property-specific review? Visit dmsellscre.com/investors or DM us to get started.
